title: MartwixPlugin's
description:
This is a simple mod for Survival that adds additional features to the game.
Version: 1.10.2
body:
Hello!
This is a simple Survival mod that adds some extra features to the game.
Here’s what it includes:

Commands

/namecolor [player] [color] [BOLD]
Changes a player’s name color. The BOLD parameter is optional.
There are 8 different colors available.

/raketa ON/OFF
Enables or disables the rocket.
The rocket launches you upward when you repeatedly press Shift.

Rocket Fuel
The rocket requires fuel to work. It accepts the following items:

Coal

Quartz

Gunpowder

Glowstone Dust

Wood

/uzemanyag
Opens a menu where you can place the required materials as fuel for the rocket.
Each time you press Shift, 1 unit of fuel is consumed.

Language

The plugin is currently only available in Hungarian.
If you speak English, please note that English language support will be added in a future update.

Version: 1.10.2
Type: Spigot
